INTERPRETATION

Keep the scope in view.

No new simulation, training or policy selection runs when you change these filters. Values are copied from the completed packages. Reported variation is sample standard deviation over three paired seeds, not a confidence interval.

Measured in simulation

Finite motor-only runs with reconstructed timing, movements and geometry. No recorded collisions or teleports in these 126 runs is an audit outcome, not field safety certification. Pedestrian service, physical sensing/radio, competing emergency vehicles and roadside acceptance remain unvalidated.

Inspect the source

Download the source tables, protocols and audit summaries with package/member SHA-256 fingerprints. Full native XML and reproduction scripts remain in the original study packages; they are not replaced by this compact viewer.
